title: StockReservationReleased
description: Reply (ADR 0006). Published by inventory-service through its outbox (aggregateType=StockReservation, key=orderId). Consumed by order-service, which deduplicates by (orderId, causationId, eventType) and saga state. The order's stock lifecycle is closed. Lists every line with its final status.

merchantId.description: Owner of the order's store. inventory scopes every read and write by merchantId + storeId.

orderId.description: Saga id and Kafka key; one order belongs to one store (BR-ORD-01).

causationId.description: eventId of the command this replies to; null for StockReservationExpired.

replayed.description: true when the command was a duplicate and this reply only describes the current state (BR-INV-07). It has a new eventId.

restock.description: The value fixed by the first release.

restocked.description: true only for lines returned to stock by this order (RETURNED).
